Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis is 0207. Hold Alt, type 0207 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis also has the Unicode codepoint U+00CF, so you can type it with Alt+207 on Windows, search for U+00CF in macOS's Character Viewer, use Ï in HTML, or \00CF in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity Ï for Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis, but the numeric form Ï is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin capital letter i with diaeresis on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 0 2 0 7 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis character (Ï) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin capital letter i with diaeresis on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin capital letter i with diaeresis in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00CF"; ()
  • Python: \u00CF or chr(0xCF)
  • JavaScript: \u00CF or String.fromCodePoint(0xCF)
  • JSON: "\u00CF"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis is 0207. Hold Alt, type 0 2 0 7 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type Ï without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as Ï, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+207 not work?

Alt+207 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Capital Letter I With Diaeresis is U+00CF. You can use this value in HTML as Ï, in CSS as \00CF, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type Ï on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00CF, then click it.
